sets.title: Emphasis Types
sets.description: Identify emphasis strategies: word order, particles, and cleft constructions
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите стратегии выделения: порядок слов, частицы и расщеплённые конструкции

items.prompt: What is emphasized in: Книгу я прочитал.
items.hint: Moving an element to front or end position creates emphasis.
items.explanation: Книгу is moved to the front (topic position), emphasizing 'THE BOOK I read.' Normal order would be Я прочитал книгу.

items.prompt: Which construction means 'It was SHE who called'?
items.explanation: Это она позвонила = 'It was SHE who called.' The cleft construction Это + noun singles out the subject.

items.prompt: Он-_____ всё знает, а они нет.
items.promptEnglish: HE knows everything, but they don't.
items.hint: Contrast particle: one person vs. others.
items.explanation: The particle -то highlights contrast: 'HE (unlike them) knows everything.'

items.prompt: _____ этот фильм я хотел посмотреть! (specifically THIS movie)
items.promptEnglish: THIS is EXACTLY the movie I wanted to watch!
items.explanation: Именно этот фильм = 'specifically THIS movie.' Именно pinpoints the exact item.

items.prompt: Where does new/important information go in neutral Russian word order?
items.promptEnglish: What is the default position for the rheme?
items.hint: Theme-rheme: old info first, new info last.
items.explanation: In Russian, the rheme (new/important info) naturally goes at the end. Moving it elsewhere creates special emphasis.

items.prompt: Which sentence emphasizes WHO did the action?
items.promptEnglish: Which word order puts focus on the agent?
items.explanation: Письмо написал Борис. - the agent Борис is in end position (rheme), answering 'WHO wrote the letter?'

items.prompt: Мы _____ вчера об этом говорили! (emphatic: we DID discuss this)
items.explanation: Же adds strong emphasis: 'We DID discuss it!' The speaker is reminding the listener of a known fact.

items.prompt: What does fronting achieve in: Вчера я его встретил.
items.promptEnglish: What is the effect of placing вчера first?
items.hint: Beginning position can set the topic or emphasize a time/place.
items.explanation: Вчера at the front = 'YESTERDAY I met him.' The time frame is the topic being set or emphasized.

sets.title: Particle Practice
sets.description: Master же, -то, именно, and как раз through minimal pairs and fill-in-the-blank
sets.descriptionRussian: Освойте частицы же, -то, именно и как раз

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ пришла! (strong emphasis: she DID come)
minimalPairs.explanation: Же adds strong emphasis to a known fact: 'She DID come!' The speaker reminds the listener.

minimalPairs.context: Она-_____ пришла, а остальные нет. (contrast: SHE came but others didn't)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: SHE came, but the rest didn't.
minimalPairs.explanation: The particle -то creates contrast: 'SHE (unlike the others) came.' It singles her out from the group.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: That's EXACTLY what I wanted to say.
minimalPairs.explanation: Именно = 'specifically, precisely this.' Used for deliberate, exact identification of what was meant.

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ собирались тебе звонить! (just now, coincidence)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We were JUST about to call you! (what a coincidence)
minimalPairs.explanation: Как раз = 'just, exactly' with a sense of coincidence or timing: 'We were JUST about to call!'

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ тебе это объяснял! (emphatic reminder: I DID explain)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I DID explain this to you!
minimalPairs.explanation: Же after the subject for emphatic reminder: 'I DID explain!' Implies frustration that the listener forgot.

minimalPairs.context: Он-_____ понимает, а ты нет. (contrast: HE understands)
minimalPairs.explanation: The particle -то separates 'him' from 'you,' creating a contrast: 'HE gets it, you don't.'

blanks: Ты _____ обещал помочь! Почему не пришёл? (you DID promise - emphatic)
Она-_____ справилась, а другие не смогли. (SHE managed, unlike others)
_____ об этом я и хотел поговорить! (precisely about this)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Emphatic particles: же, -то, именно, как раз
hints: Contrast: she succeeded vs. others failed.
Precise specification of the topic = which word?
explanations: Же adds strong emphasis: 'You DID promise!' Reminding the listener of a commitment.
The particle -то creates contrast: 'SHE managed (but the others couldn't).'
Именно = 'precisely/exactly.' Pinpoints the specific thing the speaker wanted to discuss.

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build emphatic Russian sentences from words, then translate emphatic constructions
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте эмфатические предложения из слов и переведите конструкции

translation.english: It was LENA who decided everything.
translation.hint: Cleft construction: Это + focused subject + verb

translation.english: I DID warn you about this!
translation.answer: Я же тебя об этом предупреждал!
acceptableVariants: Я же вас об этом предупреждал!
Я же тебя предупреждал об этом!

translation.english: HE knows the answer, but the others don't.
translation.answer: Он-то знает ответ, а остальные нет.
acceptableVariants: Он-то ответ знает, а остальные нет.

translation.english: That's PRECISELY what I was looking for.
translation.hint: Именно + focused element at the start

translation.english: She never DID finish the book.
translation.answer: Она так и не дочитала книгу.
acceptableVariants: Она так и не закончила книгу.
translation.hint: Emphatic negation: так и не + perfective verb

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All emphasis types in varied formats: quiz, error correction, pattern recognition, and more
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы эмфазы в разных форматах

items.prompt: Мы _____ собирались тебе звонить, когда ты написал! (just / coincidence)
items.promptEnglish: We were JUST about to call you when you texted!
items.explanation: Как раз = 'just, exactly at that moment.' It emphasizes the coincidence of timing.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a cleft construction?
items.explanation: Это Борис решил = 'It was BORIS who solved it.' The word Это before the subject creates a cleft.

items.prompt: _____ в этом городе родился мой отец. (specifically in this city)
items.promptEnglish: My father was born in THIS VERY city.
items.explanation: Именно в этом городе = 'in precisely THIS city.' Именно pinpoints the exact place.

items.prompt: Дети-_____ всё поняли, а взрослые нет. (the children understood, adults didn't)
items.promptEnglish: The CHILDREN understood everything, but the adults didn't.
items.explanation: Дети-то всё поняли = 'THE CHILDREN (unlike the adults) understood.' Contrast particle -то.

items.promptEnglish: Which version answers: 'When did he arrive?'
items.explanation: Он приехал ВЧЕРА - вчера is in end position (rheme), answering 'when?' directly.

items.prompt: Ты _____ знаешь, где ключи! (emphatic: you DO know)
items.promptEnglish: You DO know where the keys are!
items.explanation: Ты же знаешь = 'You DO know!' Же insists on a fact the listener is denying or forgetting.

items.prompt: Он так и не _____ мне правду. (He never DID tell me the truth.)
items.promptEnglish: He never DID tell me the truth.
items.hint: Так и не + perfective past = emphatic 'never did.'
items.explanation: Так и не сказал = 'never did tell.' The perfective past with так и не emphasizes an unfulfilled expectation.

items.prompt: How do you say 'It was WE who started this'?
items.explanation: Это мы начали = 'It was WE who started this.' The cleft identifies the specific agent.

items.prompt: _____ сегодня я хотел с тобой поговорить. (exactly today / coincidence)
items.promptEnglish: It's EXACTLY today that I wanted to talk to you.
items.explanation: Как раз сегодня = 'exactly today, as it happens.' Emphasizes the coincidence of timing.

errorCorrection.sentence: Это виноват он. (meant: It was HE who is guilty)
errorCorrection.hint: In a cleft, the focused element comes right after Это.
errorCorrection.explanation: Correct: Это он виноват. In a cleft construction, Это + focused subject + predicate.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я-то тебе говорил! (meant: I DID tell you - emphatic reminder)
errorCorrection.hint: Emphatic reminder = же. Contrast with others = -то.
errorCorrection.explanation: Я же тебе говорил! Же for emphatic reminder. Using -то would mean 'I (unlike someone else) told you.'

errorCorrection.sentence: Как раз это я имел в виду. (meant: SPECIFICALLY this)
errorCorrection.hint: Precise identification of what was meant = именно. Как раз = coincidence/timing.
errorCorrection.explanation: Именно это я имел в виду. Именно = specifically, precisely. Как раз leans toward coincidence.

errorCorrection.sentence: Она же пришла, а он нет. (meant: SHE came, but he didn't - contrast)
errorCorrection.hint: Contrasting one person against another = -то, not же.
errorCorrection.explanation: Она-то пришла, а он нет. The particle -то creates the contrast between her and him.

patternRecognition.sentence: Книгу я прочитал. / Задачу решил Борис. / В Москву он поехал.
patternRecognition.question: What emphasis strategy unifies these three sentences?
patternRecognition.explanation: All three move the object or destination to the front: книгу, задачу, в Москву. This gives them topic or contrastive emphasis.

patternRecognition.sentence: Это я решил. / Это она позвонила. / Это мы виноваты.
patternRecognition.question: What construction is used in all three?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use Это + subject + verb: 'It was I / she / we who...' This singles out the agent.

patternRecognition.sentence: Он-то знает. / Дети-то поняли. / Она-то пришла.
patternRecognition.question: What do all three share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use -то on the subject to contrast that person/group with others who are different: 'HE knows (others don't), THE CHILDREN understood (adults didn't).'

blanks: _____ в этот момент зазвонил телефон. (exactly at that moment - coincidence)
Мы _____ тебя предупреждали! Почему не слушал? (emphatic: we DID warn you)
Она-_____ всё сделала вовремя, а коллеги опоздали. (SHE did it on time, unlike colleagues)
_____ это я и хотел услышать! (specifically / precisely this)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: All four emphatic particles in context
hints: Emphatic reminder of a past warning.
Precise specification of what was desired.
explanations: Как раз в этот момент = 'at exactly that moment.' Emphasizes the coincidence.
Мы же тебя предупреждали! = 'We DID warn you!' Же for emphatic reminder.
Она-то всё сделала = 'SHE did everything on time (but the colleagues didn't).' Contrast with -то.
Именно это = 'precisely this.' Именно pinpoints the exact thing the speaker wanted.

minimalPairs.context: _____ Борис это сделал. (It was BORIS who did it - cleft)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: It was BORIS who did this.
minimalPairs.explanation: Это Борис это сделал - cleft construction with Это + subject to single out the person. Именно would focus on specification, not identity.

minimalPairs.context: _____ Борис это и сделал. (SPECIFICALLY Boris did this)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: It was specifically BORIS who did this.
minimalPairs.explanation: Именно Борис = 'specifically/precisely Boris.' Именно specifies the exact person out of several possibilities.

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ говорили об этом! (we DID talk about this - reminder)
minimalPairs.explanation: Мы же говорили = 'We DID talk about this!' Же is for emphatic reminders of known facts.

minimalPairs.context: Мы-_____ говорили, а вы не слушали. (WE spoke, but you didn't listen - contrast)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: WE spoke, but you weren't listening. (contrast)
minimalPairs.explanation: Мы-то говорили = 'WE (on our part) spoke.' The -то contrasts 'us speaking' with 'you not listening.'
